verse.verse_1: Greed for more and more distracted you [from God]
verse.verse_3: But you will soon come to know.
verse.verse_4: But you will soon come to know.
verse.verse_5: Indeed, were you to know the truth with certainty,
verse.verse_6: you would see the fire of Hell.
verse.verse_7: You would see it with the eye of certainty.
verse.verse_8: Then on that Day you shall be questioned about your worldly favours.
